summary: Beasley Broadcast Group filed an 8-K on August 24, 2026, disclosing that Nasdaq confirmed the company regained compliance with the Minimum Stockholders Equity Requirement under Listing Rule 5550(b)(1). The notice followed an April 13, 2026 deficiency notification. The company's common stock remains listed on Nasdaq under BBGI. No transaction, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event is involved; this is a routine compliance update concerning continued listing status.
